question: Will Arda Güler have ≥2 shots on target vs Valencia CF on Nov 7, 2026?
outcomes: No, fewer than 2 shots on target

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes, ≥2 shots on target": Wins if Arda Güler records 2 or more shots on target in the LaLiga match between Valencia CF and Real Madrid, played strictly after 2026-11-05T22:02:56Z and with the official result confirmed at or before 2026-11-08T04:00:00Z.
- "No, fewer than 2 shots on target": Wins if Arda Güler records 0 or 1 shots on target in that match, or if he does not appear in the match (did not play any minutes).

Clarifications:
- "Shots on target" is defined as any attempt by Arda Güler that is on goal (would have gone in if not saved or blocked on the line), excluding shots blocked by an outfield player before reaching the goalkeeper. The stat used is the official player-level shots on target figure for the Valencia CF vs Real Madrid LaLiga Matchweek 12 fixture on November 7, 2026.
